```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =============================================================================
# FINAL REPORT OUTPUT SETUP
# =============================================================================

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(gt)

# File locations

data_dir <- "/Users/katz/Desktop/UNi Year 4/Semester 2/ALM/"

output_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "ACTL4002_ESG_outputs")
report_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "report")

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  stop(
    "ACTL4002_ESG_outputs was not found. Run ACTL4002_ESG_FINAL.Rmd first."
  )
}

dir.create(report_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

stale_report_outputs <- list.files(
  report_dir,
  pattern = "^(Table_|Figure_).*(\\.png|\\.svg)$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(stale_report_outputs) > 0) {
  unlink(stale_report_outputs, force = TRUE)
}

# Final report dimensions and palette

WORD_BODY_WIDTH_IN <- 6.27
CSS_PX_PER_IN <- 96
GT_VIEWPORT_WIDTH <- round(WORD_BODY_WIDTH_IN * CSS_PX_PER_IN)
GT_SCREENSHOT_ZOOM <- 3
PT_TO_CSS_PX <- 96 / 72

pt_css <- function(x) gt::px(x * PT_TO_CSS_PX)

pal <- list(
  orange = "#F28C28",
  orange_dark = "#D97706",
  black = "#111111",
  grey_dark = "#4B4B4B",
  grey = "#7A7A7A",
  grey_light = "#D9D9D9",
  grey_pale = "#F2F2F2",
  white = "#FFFFFF"
)

read_output <- function(stem) {
  path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(stem, ".csv"))
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("Required pipeline output not found: ", basename(path))
  }
  readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
}

style_report_gt <- function(gt_obj, first_column_left = TRUE) {
  out <- gt_obj %>%
    tab_options(
      table.width = pct(100),
      table.background.color = pal$white,
      table.border.top.color = pal$orange,
      table.border.top.width = px(4),
      table.border.bottom.color = pal$orange,
      table.border.bottom.width = px(2),
      table.font.size = pt_css(10),
      table.font.names = c("Arial", "Helvetica", "sans-serif"),
      heading.background.color = pal$black,
      heading.title.font.size = pt_css(12.5),
      heading.subtitle.font.size = pt_css(9.5),
      heading.title.font.weight = "bold",
      heading.align = "left",
      heading.padding = px(9),
      column_labels.background.color = pal$orange,
      column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
      column_labels.font.size = pt_css(10),
      column_labels.padding = px(8),
      row.striping.background_color = pal$grey_pale,
      data_row.padding = px(7)
    ) %>%
    opt_row_striping() %>%
    cols_align(align = "center") %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(color = pal$white, weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_title(groups = "title")
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(color = pal$grey_light),
      locations = cells_title(groups = "subtitle")
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(color = pal$black, weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
    )

  if (first_column_left) {
    first_col <- names(gt_obj[["_data"]])[1]
    out <- out %>%
      cols_align(align = "left", columns = all_of(first_col))
  }

  out
}

export_table <- function(gt_obj, number, stem) {
  filename <- sprintf("Table_%02d_%s.png", number, stem)

  gt::gtsave(
    gt_obj,
    file.path(report_dir, filename),
    vwidth = GT_VIEWPORT_WIDTH,
    zoom = GT_SCREENSHOT_ZOOM,
    expand = 5
  )

  invisible(gt_obj)
}

theme_report <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold", size = 13, colour = pal$black,
        margin = margin(b = 4)
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 10.5, colour = pal$grey_dark,
        margin = margin(b = 7)
      ),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, colour = pal$grey),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold", colour = pal$black),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10, colour = pal$grey_dark),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", colour = pal$black),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10, colour = pal$grey_dark),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = pal$grey_light, linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = pal$white, colour = NA),
      plot.margin = margin(7, 7, 7, 7)
    )
}

export_figure <- function(plot_obj, number, stem, aspect_ratio = 1.80) {
  filename <- sprintf("Figure_%02d_%s.png", number, stem)
  width_in <- WORD_BODY_WIDTH_IN
  height_in <- width_in / aspect_ratio

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(report_dir, filename),
    plot = plot_obj + theme_report(),
    width = width_in,
    height = height_in,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 320,
    bg = "white"
  )

  invisible(plot_obj)
}
```

```{r derive-regime-summary}
portfolio_vol_by_state <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    state_order,
    function(s) {
      vols <- regime_params %>%
        filter(State == s) %>%
        mutate(Asset = factor(Asset, levels = asset_order)) %>%
        arrange(Asset) %>%
        pull(Vol_annualised)

      corr_s <- regime_corr %>%
        filter(State == s) %>%
        mutate(
          Asset_1 = factor(Asset_1, levels = asset_order),
          Asset_2 = factor(Asset_2, levels = asset_order)
        ) %>%
        arrange(Asset_1, Asset_2) %>%
        select(Asset_1, Asset_2, Correlation) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = Asset_2, values_from = Correlation) %>%
        arrange(Asset_1)

      corr_matrix <- as.matrix(corr_s[, asset_order])
      sigma_matrix <- diag(vols) %*% corr_matrix %*% diag(vols)

      tibble::tibble(
        State = s,
        Portfolio_Volatility = sqrt(
          as.numeric(t(weights) %*% sigma_matrix %*% weights)
        )
      )
    }
  )
)

regime_summary <- regime_params %>%
  mutate(
    Weight = weights[Asset],
    Weighted_RP = Mean_annualised_risk_premium_cc * Weight,
    Weighted_Total = Mean_annualised_cc * Weight
  ) %>%
  group_by(State) %>%
  summarise(
    Portfolio_RP = sum(Weighted_RP),
    Implied_Total_Return = sum(Weighted_Total),
    Historical_Occupancy = first(Smoothed_Occupancy),
    Expected_Duration_Months = first(Expected_Duration_Months),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(portfolio_vol_by_state, by = "State") %>%
  mutate(State = factor(State, levels = state_order)) %>%
  arrange(State)
```

```{r figure-01}
fig_01 <- ggplot(
  capital_plot_data,
  aes(x = Metric, y = Value, fill = Model)
) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.74), width = 0.64) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Value)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.74),
    vjust = -0.35,
    size = 3.6
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Benchmark = pal$black, HMM = pal$orange)) +
  expand_limits(y = max(capital_plot_data$Value) * 1.12) +
  labs(
    title = "Economic Impact of the HMM",
    subtitle = "Regime-dependent tail behaviour materially increases capital requirements",
    x = NULL,
    y = "AUD per AUD100 initial supporting assets",
    fill = NULL
  )

export_figure(fig_01, 1, "Capital_Comparison", aspect_ratio = 1.85)
fig_01 + theme_report()
```

```{r figure-02}
annual_tail_data <- annual_comparison %>%
  select(Model, Q005_Return, Q01_Return, Q05_Return) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Q005_Return, Q01_Return, Q05_Return),
    names_to = "Quantile",
    values_to = "Return"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Quantile = factor(
      Quantile,
      levels = c("Q005_Return", "Q01_Return", "Q05_Return"),
      labels = c("0.5%", "1%", "5%")
    ),
    Model = factor(Model, levels = c("Historical rolling 12m", "Benchmark", "HMM"))
  )

fig_02 <- ggplot(
  annual_tail_data,
  aes(x = Quantile, y = Return, colour = Model, group = Model)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Historical rolling 12m" = pal$grey_dark,
      "Benchmark" = pal$black,
      "HMM" = pal$orange
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "One-Year Portfolio Downside Quantiles",
    subtitle = "Historical rolling outcomes compared with Benchmark and HMM simulations",
    x = "Lower-tail probability",
    y = "One-year portfolio return",
    colour = NULL
  )

export_figure(fig_02, 2, "Lower_Tail_Quantiles", aspect_ratio = 1.80)
fig_02 + theme_report()
```

```{r figure-03}
calibration_plot_data <- calibration_sensitivity %>%
  select(Calibration_Years, Benchmark_REC_T0, HMM_REC_T0) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Benchmark_REC_T0, HMM_REC_T0),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "REC_T0"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Benchmark_REC_T0 = "Benchmark",
      HMM_REC_T0 = "HMM"
    )
  )

fig_03 <- ggplot(
  calibration_plot_data,
  aes(x = Calibration_Years, y = REC_T0, colour = Model, group = Model)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Benchmark = pal$black, HMM = pal$orange)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(20, 25, 30)) +
  labs(
    title = "Calibration-Window Sensitivity of Required Economic Capital",
    subtitle = "All other projection and simulation assumptions held constant",
    x = "Historical calibration window (years)",
    y = "Required Economic Capital at T0",
    colour = NULL
  )

export_figure(fig_03, 3, "Calibration_Window_REC", aspect_ratio = 1.80)
fig_03 + theme_report()
```

```{r final-output-check}
expected_report_files <- c(
  sprintf("Table_%02d_%s.png", 1:10, c(
    "Asset_Market_Proxies",
    "Historical_Risk_Premium_Characteristics",
    "Benchmark_Parameters",
    "HMM_State_Count_Selection",
    "HMM_Portfolio_Regime_Summary",
    "HMM_State_Dependent_Correlations",
    "One_Year_Portfolio_Validation",
    "Economic_Balance_Sheet",
    "Investment_Strategy_Comparison",
    "Calibration_Window_Sensitivity"
  )),
  sprintf("Figure_%02d_%s.png", 1:3, c(
    "Capital_Comparison",
    "Lower_Tail_Quantiles",
    "Calibration_Window_REC"
  ))
)

report_check <- tibble::tibble(
  File = expected_report_files,
  Exists = file.exists(file.path(report_dir, expected_report_files))
)

if (!all(report_check$Exists)) {
  warning(
    "Some final report files were not created:\n",
    paste(report_check$File[!report_check$Exists], collapse = "\n")
  )
}

knitr::kable(
  report_check,
  caption = "Final report files — one version of each"
)

message("Final report outputs saved in: ", report_dir)
```
